gripOrHq.title: Corporate War
gripOrHq.rulesText: If you have [12] or more bits in your pool when you score Corporate War, gain [12]; otherwise, lose all bits.

gripOrHq.title: Project Consultants
gripOrHq.rulesText: Add four advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

gripOrHq.title: Fortress Architects
gripOrHq.rulesText: Cost to install ice is reduced by [1].

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

scoreArea.title: Hostile Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [5] when you score Hostile Takeover.

ice.title: Haunting Inquisition
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Runner cannot make another run during his or her next six actions.
[Subroutine] End the run.
